youtubeTitle: Nobody remembers the odds you were up against - only whether you held the line.
caption:
Nobody remembers the odds you were up against - only whether you held the line.

The scoreboard rarely records how outnumbered you were, how little backup you had or how reasonable it would have been to fold. It only records whether you stayed. Show up for the unglamorous version of that today.
